en: Rūpāvacaraduka (The Dyad on the Fine-Material Sphere)
Dependent on a non-fine-material-sphere state, a non-fine-material-sphere state arises by way of root condition … three.
Dependent on a non-non-fine-material-sphere state, a non-non-fine-material-sphere state arises by way of root condition … three.
Dependent on both a non-fine-material-sphere and a non-non-fine-material-sphere state, a non-fine-material-sphere state arises by way of root condition … three. (Abbreviated.)

In the case of the root condition, there are nine; in the object condition, four; in the predominance condition, five ... [and so on] ... in the mutuality condition, six ... [and so on] ... in the prenascence and repetition conditions, two ... [and so on] ... in the non-disappearance condition, nine.
